_readme: Copy to config/sites.json and replace every null before running: python -m lunavi_science build --config config/sites.json --out out

Paths are relative to this file. The DEM paths below assume the files were downloaded into ScienceService/data/; /vsicurl/https://... URLs to the cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs listed on the PGDA product pages also work.

Site coordinates must come from a citable source, e.g. the region-of-interest shapefiles on the PGDA product 78 page (SiteXX_ROIs.tgz) or the Wueller et al. (2026) Landing_Sites shapefile (CC BY 4.0). The builder refuses sites without latitude, longitude and coordinateSource.
Latitude is planetocentric (negative south), longitude east-positive, both in the MOON_ME (DE421) frame of the LOLA products.
ephemerisLabel: NAIF DE421 planetary ephemeris + MOON_ME (moon_080317.tf, moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc)

dem._note: Priority order: 5 m/pixel site tiles first (PGDA product 78; each covers about 16 x 16 km around one site), the regional DEM last (PGDA product 90) for the far horizon. boundsPaddingM limits what is read and must exceed model.maxDistanceM for the far-field layer; resolutionM averages the raster down on read to save memory.

basemap._note: Without hillshadePath the basemap is shaded relief rendered from the DEM layers. To use the product 90 hillshade instead, set hillshadePath to ../data/LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ_HILL.TIF (and hillshadeResolutionM, e.g. 40, to read it at lower resolution).
